Date: Thu, 11 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: transfer assurance packet and SCCs mapping

Hi Laura,

Thanks for the recent demo — Acme Health is moving quickly and our legal/compliance team needs a compact transfer assurance packet to complete our procurement checklist. Specifically we need: 

- A short Transfer Impact Assessment (TIA) summary that explains what data categories might transfer to the US and the mitigations you apply (encryption in transit+at rest, KV cache handling, retention controls).
- A mapping document showing which standard contractual clauses (SCCs) / equivalent mechanisms are used and where (hosted vs dedicated vs private).
- A redacted SOC 2 report or a SOC 2 summary that confirms data handling controls (or a pointer to your SOC auditor).
- A short DPIA summary and any customer-facing configuration notes (e.g., ability to pin model versions, private deployment options).

Do you have a single packet (PDF + spreadsheet) you can send? We are on a tight timeline — legal would like materials by end of day Friday PT if possible.

If there's anything sensitive you prefer to share via SFTP/secure drive, let me know and we'll provide an upload location.

Best,
Sara Milton
Data Protection Officer
Acme Health

Hi Sara — attaching the initial transfer assurance packet per your request. This is intended to be customer-facing; if you need additional redaction or a more detailed technical annex, we can provide that next.

What’s attached:
- TIA_packet_v1.pdf — 2-page summary of likely transfer scopes, risk assessment, and mitigations (encryption, retention, prefix/KV caching notes).
- SCC_mapping_acme.xlsx — mapping of SCC clauses to Redwood controls, with notes for hosted/dedicated/private.
- SOC2_summary_redacted.pdf — scope and auditor statement (sensitive bits redacted).
- DPIA_summary.docx — short customer-facing DPIA summary and recommended customer configurations to minimize transfer surface.

Short answers to the points you raised:
- Transfer mechanisms: For hosted customers we rely on SCCs + technical safeguards (encryption in transit+at rest, strict RBAC). Dedicated customers get a reserved capacity boundary and stronger isolation; Private deployments allow customer-managed KMS/HSM which reduces transfer risk because keys never leave the customer's environment.
- HSM/KMS: For Private we provide an integration guide; for Dedicated you can bring your own KMS or use our managed KMS with customer-controlled keys. Vivek included a one-page ops note in the SCC spreadsheet.
- SOC2: redacted summary attached; full SOC2 can be shared under an NDA if required.

Next steps: If this packet satisfies your legal checklist we can mark the procurement item as complete. If you need a signed addendum or more depth (e.g., full architecture diagrams), tell us which items you want expanded and we will follow up.

Drive folder (secure): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B3cAcme-TIA
HubSpot record: HS-64281

Thanks and happy to hop on a 30-minute call with your DPO/legal team to walk through the packet — availability Fri 11:00–13:00 PT.

Best,
